suggested_issue_title: Aspose.GIS.FOSS for .Net: no license file at the repository root
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

At revision `b9b8c9c760bf02f6e7f06438feeabb3d0e43c1e4` the repository has no license file at its root.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-gis-foss/Aspose.GIS.FOSS-for-.Net
- Revision: `b9b8c9c760bf02f6e7f06438feeabb3d0e43c1e4` (the upstream revision this report was verified against)

## Steps to reproduce

```
git ls-tree --name-only b9b8c9c760bf02f6e7f06438feeabb3d0e43c1e4
gh api repos/aspose-gis-foss/Aspose.GIS.FOSS-for-.Net --jq .license
```

## Expected

A license file at the repository root (for example `LICENSE`), so GitHub license detection and package scanners, which read only the root, can identify the license.

## Actual

The root listing has no license file, and none exists elsewhere in the tree.
